root_cause: Production contained Supabase migration versions that were not represented by SQL files in the canonical GitHub migration directory, so the Supabase Preview integration failed after merge with remote migration versions not found locally.
prevention: Require the Supabase Preview check on protected main in addition to Required test and CodeQL.
Treat any remote-only Supabase migration version as a release-blocking repository parity failure.
Recover missing migration files from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations statements rather than creating placeholders.
Keep production runtime readback and repository migration-history readback in the same terminal delivery lineage.

Keep remote-applied migration SQL as immutable production history evidence. If fresh replay requires different behavior, preserve the exact applied blob under supabase/migration-history/immutable and allow executable divergence only through supabase/migration-replay-overrides.json.
Never bypass or disable a current safety/truth trigger to make historical replay pass; narrow the historical side effect fail-closed instead.
